Keep every head, umbrella and foot fully visible with generous transparent separation. Keep face dimensions, torso length, feet position, umbrella height and camera constant throughout. No abrupt outstretched-to-rest switch, no mood jump, no body shrinking, no detached hands, no umbrella bending, no blue eye whites, no background, labels, borders or shadows. All twelve drawings should be consistently full-body and suitable for a one-shot response on a small watch.

entries.prompt: Create a new eight-drawing Patrick Star cartoon animation sheet for a personal watch companion, using the attached standing raincoat character only as the reference for his identity and clean flat cartoon drawing style. New outfit: mint-green bucket hat, sky-blue short explorer vest with pockets, small orange backpack with visible straps, purple-flowered green shorts, pink bare feet. He is a cheerful but slightly confused explorer, not wearing a raincoat and not holding an umbrella. He holds a small cream folded map with simple colored route lines, no text. Four columns by two rows, eight fully isolated full-body drawings on genuine transparency, generous gaps all around. Camera, character size, head width, body length, hat and feet positions stay consistent. Action in reading order: 1 looking forward with folded map near belly; 2 glances down; 3 starts unfolding map; 4 holds open map at belly height, puzzled brow; 5 looks left over the map; 6 looks right with one raised eyebrow; 7 folds map halfway; 8 folded map and looks forward with a knowing small smile, returns to initial body pose. Draw actual hand and map progression with clear gripping contact. White eye whites, pink eyelids. Bold smooth black outlines and bright flat colors matching the familiar animated character. No realistic gross details, background, shadows, text, cell borders, extra figures, missing fingers/arms, clipped hat or feet.

Use case: illustration-story. New animation artwork for a personal Patrick Star watch companion. Make eight distinct full-body cartoon drawings arranged four columns and two rows on a truly transparent background. Patrick is standing in a navy-and-cream horizontally striped short-sleeved pajama top, matching loose pajama shorts, a drooping small mustard nightcap with a pompom, and pink bare feet. His rounded star body and broad belly are visibly consistent in every drawing. He holds a tiny teal mug with a star motif in both hands at belly height. Mood: a reluctant early riser, dry and funny, not always smiling. Sequence: 1 sleepy half-open eyes holding cup at belly; 2 looks at cup; 3 lifts cup a little; 4 lifts cup to chest; 5 cup touches his mouth for one sip; 6 lowers cup to chest; 7 lowers cup to belly and opens eyes; 8 small satisfied smile holding cup at belly. Cup stays upright with natural continuous hand contact. Keep face width, torso length, foot baseline and camera constant across all eight drawings. Flat bright color, clean smooth black outlines, familiar SpongeBob cartoon aesthetic. White eye whites and pink lids. Generous empty transparent margins between all characters; show the entire hat, arms, mug and feet. No background, realistic textures, floor shadows, text or cell borders.

An eight-frame animation sprite sheet of Patrick Star wearing a coral-red sports headband, turquoise athletic tank top, green shorts with purple flowers, and a white towel loosely draped around his neck. Full-body standing character with pink bare feet. Familiar clean flat 2D SpongeBob cartoon style. Truly transparent background. Four columns, two rows, eight separate consistently sized drawings with large clear margins. Animation: 1 tired after exercise, towel hanging down; 2 right hand grasps the right towel end; 3 lifts towel toward cheek; 4 towel dabs right cheek gently without covering eyes; 5 holds the dab and closes eyes contentedly with pink eyelids; 6 moves towel away from cheek; 7 lowers towel back to neck; 8 returns hand to side with a proud little smile. Draw every intermediate hand and towel pose clearly, preserving physical contact. The left hand rests at the side. Head width, torso size, feet baseline, and clothing remain identical across drawings. White eye whites. No weights, running, body bouncing, perspective change, floating towel, background, labels, cell borders, shadows, or cropped body parts.
